- If a declaration is genuinely beyond you this turn, LEAVE its `sorry` exactly as it is (do not replace it with a fake discharge) and report honestly that you could not prove it, naming the decl and the concrete blocker (missing lemma, unclear step, integrability side-condition, etc.). - The only CausalSmith imports you may add or retain are same-run modules under `CausalSmith.Substrate.DependentOrbitKernelPosteriorRisk.*`. blocker. Run the actual targeted build (`lake build <edited modules>` from the `CausalSmith`
